name: Maria Rodriguez
source: Ms. Maria Rodriguez is the math teacher at Arlington Academy. She is very demanding, assigns multiple pages of homework per class and is ruthless when it comes to giving detention to rebellious students. Despite being stern, she's quite understanding and kind when she wants to be.
